speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (a) how many consumers enjoy tax rebates under the Commercial Vehicle Emissions Scheme (CVES) since its implementation; and (b) whether the Ministry will consider delaying the stepdown in incentives announced on 15 November 2022 on adjustments to the CVES.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: Under the Commercial Vehicle Emissions Scheme or CVES, purchasers of cleaner light commercial vehicles receive a cash incentive to defray the purchase cost.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
text: The CVES was due to end on 31 March 2023.

speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
text: Will the Ministry consider further extension of this scheme?

speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
text: The feedback from the commercial users is that it has been extremely helpful for them for the conversion.

speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
text: If this scheme is removed, then their cost will go up.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: Of course, we hope that more vehicle owners will switch to cleaner vehicles.

speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
text: So, we would like to urge all light commercial vehicles owners to make good use of this extension and help us towards achieving a cleaner target for Singapore.
